headings.instruction: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Keep leading tight (leading-none).

body.instruction: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to give a highly technical, precise feel. Keep tracking normal and leading relaxed.

marquee.instruction: Massive text for marquee (text-7xl or larger), transparent with text-stroke or solid muted.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32 for sections.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: The 'Tetris' Grid (Mode A) for the Services section. Asymmetry, Visual Tension, Art. Use wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12).
spacing_and_layout.containers: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic large hero text with on-load masked line-by-line reveal. Use Framer Motion: wrap text lines in a container with overflow-hidden, and animate the text's 'y' property from 100% to 0%.
motion.scroll_reveal: Framer motion scroll reveals for all major sections (fade up, slow transition).
motion.smooth_scroll: Implement Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It adds weight and makes the site feel premium.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on images in the services section using Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform.

sections_blueprint.details: Sticky header (z-50) with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-black/60. Minimal logo 'Núcleo Digital' on left, links (Inicio, Servicios, Manifiesto, Contacto) on right. Primary CTA button.

Massive heading 'Software que impulsa tu negocio'. Line-by-line reveal. Background: Deep Void Black. Subtle 3D/abstract glow or tech element behind the text. Primary CTA 'Inicia tu Proyecto'. Padding: py-32.
Swiss layout. 3 numbered chapters (01. Precisión, 02. Velocidad, 03. Escalabilidad). Huge '01' numbers (text-6xl text-primary). Staggered layout. High contrast text. Emotional, authoritative copy.
Use react-fast-marquee. 'NÚCLEO DIGITAL — SOFTWARE QUE IMPULSA TU NEGOCIO —'. Slow drift. Outline text style (text-transparent stroke-white) mixed with solid text.

Grid cols 1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Images treated deliberately (spotlight, clipped frames). Cards have 1px border-white/10 and flat dark background.
- Creación de páginas web (col-span-8 row-span-2)
- Apps para ventas (col-span-4 row-span-1)
- Apps de inventario (col-span-4 row-span-1)
- Recolección de datos (col-span-full md:col-span-12 row-span-1 wide layout).
Minimalist contact form (Name, Email, Message). Functional look. Shadcn UI Input/Textarea highly customized (dark mode, square corners, 1px borders). Uses solid Signal Red submit button.
Bottom right fixed WhatsApp icon button. Green background. Hover scale up.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) for services. Glassmorphism for Header. Solid dark flat surfaces for cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate strokes (border-white/10). No soft shadows on dark mode. High contrast.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) across the whole site to give a premium, tactile 'film' quality.

component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Strip generic styles, make them fit the Swiss Brutalist theme.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). High contrast hover states.

web_creation.description: Laptop on wooden desk in dark environment. For 'Creación de páginas web' service.

sales_apps.description: Smartphone displaying apps dark. For 'Apps para ventas'.

inventory_apps.description: Dark narrow warehouse aisle. For 'Apps de inventario'.

data_collection.description: 3D computer graphics red/dark. For 'Recolección de datos'.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract blue glowing dots. Optional for background textures.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use transparent background in header. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60.
Do not center align the main App container. Leave text-align left.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in a top-level wrapper.
Use Framer Motion for line-by-line reveal in Hero.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Create depth through layered design and z-index hierarchy, but keep shadows minimal in dark mode (prefer borders).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Use APCA guidelines. Signal Red CTA with White text must be legible.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all Framer Motion animations.
